name: TAG CRM
body:
> Project · 2026-10-21

# Summary
TAG CRM is a single-file, LeadSnap-style CRM prototype (`TAG-CRM\index.html`, about 80 KB) that runs entirely in the browser and saves its data in `localStorage` (key `tag-crm-v1`). There is no server or database.

# Sections
- **Workspace:** Dashboard, Leads, Pipelines (deals), Calls, Tasks.
- **Agency:** Companies (with a company switcher and "All companies" scope), Automations, Reports, Spam Blocking, Settings.
- Contact records include deals, calls, notes, a timeline, an onboarding checklist and actions; templates support merge fields that can be copied.

# Important limits
- **Automations are simulated only.** The app has buttons like "Simulate form submission", "Simulate answered call" and "Simulate missed call", and notes that sending stays simulated until a real sender is connected. Real call data would need a call-tracking export.
- Data lives only in the browser that created it; clearing site data erases it.

# Relationship to other projects
- It is a lightweight sketch of CRM ideas; the full, database-backed build is [AIO SEO CRM](lib:brain-aio-seo-crm). Real client lead data lives in [Keystone CRM](lib:brain-keystone-crm) and [GoHighLevel](lib:brain-gohighlevel).
- The Oct 1 handoff also mentions an earlier internal CRM side project (Sep 28, localhost:3000 owner-account setup) and flags the GitHub repo `kimai-i/CRM` as public; make it private if that was not intended. Which build that repo holds is not confirmed in the files.
